subject: Context & output envelope — pricing follow-up and $/1M target
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@maple.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Context & output envelope — pricing follow-up and $/1M target

Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap and a few asks so we can size a clean pricing estimate and pilot scope.

Recap (from our convo):
- Product: long-form assistant for customer support & internal knowledge (synthesized answers + citations).
- Current traffic: ~250k MAU (you said), ~2–4 requests/user/month (we're using conservative 3).
- Profile you want us to price: mixture of short clarifications and longer context summarizations (some requests hit customer history + docs).

Our initial token profile (please confirm with your sample):
- Avg prompt tokens (observed sample): ~420 tokens
- Avg completion tokens: ~240 tokens
- Distribution estimate (call notes): ~84% requests fit small-window (<2k total), ~10% require up to 8k, ~4% up to 32k, ~2% edge/rare sessions nearing 128k (we flagged as "context blowouts").

Monthly/volume assumptions you mentioned (we used these to derive unit-econ):
- MAU: 250k
- Avg requests per MAU: 3 => ~750k requests/month
- Token buckets (rough): 750k * (420+240) ≈ 495M tokens/month (this is a starting point before caching and batching gains).

Questions for you (short):
1) Can you attach a 24–72 hr sample of actual prompts & completions (anonymized)? We attached the recording and our token-sample template — paste a small CSV into the template if possible.
2) Can you confirm approximate percent of requests that reference the same user history (i.e., are cacheable vs unique)?
3) Who is the budget owner and procurement lead (name + email)?

Preliminary Redwood guidance (high level):
- Hosted estimate (no commit): target list estimate ballpark $95 / 1M tokens for this mix, with auto-batching, prefix caching and aggressive KV cache enabled.
- Dedicated / reserved (1yr commit): we can approach ~$60–$75 / 1M tokens depending on guaranteed throughput and cache hit assumptions.
- Caching impact: with moderate repetition (20–30% repeated prefixes) you can see effective token usage drop 15–35% depending on hit distribution.
- Context tiers: if >8k requests exceed ~8–10% of traffic or >32k exceed ~1–2% we recommend a hybrid routing policy (most requests to a high-throughput 8k variant, long-context routed to 32k/128k pool).

Attachments: call-recording-20260914.mp3; maple_token_sample.csv (template).

Next steps proposed:
- Sarah provides token sample (24–72h) and confirms cacheable fraction + procurement contact.
- Redwood delivers a 2-week pilot estimate and pricing worksheet (we'll propose an A/B pilot to validate cache hit).
- Kickoff to scope SSO/KMS/audit checklist once budget owner signs.

If you confirm the sample, we'll turn around an initial pricing workbook and a 14-day pilot SOW by EOD (next business day).

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context & output envelope — pricing follow-up and $/1M target

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Attaching a 48-hr anonymized export (maple_token_sample_v2.csv) from our staging traffic — headers: request_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, documented_context_size.

Quick answers:
- Based on the sample, updated distribution is roughly: 88% <2k, 10% up to 8k, ~1.8% up to 32k, ~0.2% near 128k.
- Cacheable fraction (approx): ~18% of requests reuse a previous prompt or prefix in our current dataset.
- MAU and request assumptions: confirmed 250k MAU; product team expects growth but use 3 rps/user/month for now.
- Procurement/budget owner: Lisa Chen (lisa.chen@maple.ai) — cc'ing her on next thread.

Questions for Redwood: can you provide a quick $/1M estimate for both hosted and dedicated given our sample distribution? Also — does Redwood support prefix-level caching for staff-specific history without broader dedup? That matters for privacy.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Jensen
Dir. ML Product, Maple.ai
sarah.jensen@maple.ai

Attachment: maple_token_sample_v2.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@maple.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context & output envelope — pricing follow-up and $/1M target

Sarah — great data, appreciate the quick sample. I reviewed the CSV and ran a lightweight estimate. High-level pricing guidance (based on your distribution and 18% cacheable):

Hosted (no commit):
- Effective tokens/month (after 18% cache hit and assuming current mix): ~405M tokens
- Price band (hosted, with batching/caching): $85–$105 / 1M tokens
- Recommended pilot: 14 days, cap at 30M tokens total to validate hit rates and p50 latency.

Dedicated (1yr commit):
- With a 1yr commit and predictable throughput we can get to ~$58–$72 / 1M tokens (final depends on exact commit and burst allowances).
- Dedicated also gives you private KMS/HSM and VPC peering options for compliance.

Context sizing recommendation:
- Default route: use an optimized 8k model for the 90% of traffic (small + mid requests).
- Long context pool: a smaller fraction of requests (1–2%) should be routed to the 32k pool; for the rare 128k blowouts, enforce guardrails (size-check + human review) and consider a pay-per-use surcharge.

Caching & privacy:
- We support prefix-level KV caching scoped to tenant or user. By default it's tenant-scoped; we can restrict to user-scoped caches for privacy (no cross-tenant leakage). We'll document the TTL and eviction policy in the SOW.

I've attached a starter workbook: redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx (ballpark calc). Next steps I propose:
1) Budget approval from Lisa (cc'd).
2) Redwood sends pilot SOW and pilot-run playbook (14 days).
3) Kickoff to scope identity and KMS needs (we'll invite infra + security).

If that sounds good we'll draft the SOW and estimated pricing lines for Lisa to review.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx
